column3: Kirino Route · There's No Way My Little Sister Has Interest In Comiket Now
Yeah, got it. Well then, I'l call you once I'm there.
Hanging up the call with Saori, I stuffed my cellphone into my pocket.
We'll be going to Comiket today as planned previously. The call was regarding me asking Kirino to come along.
But...
Kirino sat on the sofa, reading her fashion magazine with a blank look.
She's been like that ever since that incident.
When we meet each other at home, not only do we not talk to each other, we don't even look at each other's faces.
Our relationship might be much worse than a year ago.
It's clear that she heard the conversation on the phone, yet she purposely tries to ignore it...
Sorry... Saori, I think it's pointless to invite her in this state.
...Hmm? It feels that I'm being watched by someone...?
...Just now... For a moment, did Kirino's eyes meet mine?
By any chance, does she want to go to Comiket? ...That can't be.
But now, it could be due to a lack of judgment on my part, but Kirino seems to have a lonely look on her face.
...I might have made a mistake somewhere.
Such thoughts run through my mind as I stand at the front door.
But, since the current Kirino denies her friendship with Saori and Kuroneko, it's impossible for me to acknowledge her.
Even so, my heart still wishes that us siblings could have fun together with Saori and Kuroneko once again. I'm sure she thinks the same.
So, Kirino. Someday when your memories have returned, let's go to Comiket together again.
As I muttered such thoughts in my mind, I walked out of the house.
